itens.trecho: Um exemplo de filme que não precisa de milhões de dólares para ser eficiente - e consequentemente, um sucesso. Uma locação maravilhosa, ótimo roteiro, grandes atuações (Song Kang-ho é, sem dúvida, um dos melhores atores do país), trilha sonora de primeira, somada com a desgraceira sul-coreana tradicional.

The working class and down on their luck Kim family struggle to make ends meet. When a friend of the son, Ki-Woo’s, who is an English tutor for the daughter in the wealthy Park family, has to leave his position, he recommends Ki-Woo for the job.

This is VERY HIGHLY OVERRATED. The most part of the movie is foul-playing, most of those scenes seem to have been copied from the 1999/old Vijay’s movie: Minsaara Kannan [IMDB: (Warning: This again might be a copy of some other movie as well].
